versions.changelog: Require versioned official CLI archives and SHA-256 verification before execution; remove mutable shell installer. Includes full current CLI discovery, public Domains MCP, Hosting, Email, Platform apps and ANS guidance.

Replace legacy wrappers with official gddy workflows; add public Domains MCP setup, REST/GraphQL discovery, beta Hosting and Email, experimental Platform apps, and ANS guidance. Verified against gddy v0.2.12.
Remove bundled node_modules — install via npm install in scripts/mcp-server/ instead

- Initial release of the GoDaddy API skill.
- Provides shell scripts for managing domains, DNS, certificates, shoppers, subscriptions, agreements, countries, and aftermarket listings.
- Includes an MCP server to expose all operations programmatically.
- Destructive and financial actions require confirmation for safety.
- Detailed documentation and references included for endpoints, authentication, payloads, error handling, and safe operation guidelines.
